source_conflict.summary: Official and aggregate status signals are aligned.

official.summary: Epic Games Statuspage API: All Systems Operational

updates.title: Epic Games Statuspage API: All Systems Operational
Fortnite Matchmaking Issue
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / Matchmaking has returned to normal and you should be able to queue up again without issue.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issue
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We are continuing to investigate this issue.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issue
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We're seeing matchmaking errors in other regions as well, requiring you to queue up more than once to find a match. We'll let you know as we have more updates and this is back to normal.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issue
updates.meta: Monitoring / Major / Resolved / We're working to resolve matchmaking errors in the ME server region preventing players queueing into a game.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking, Login & Locker Service Errors
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / This incident has been resolved.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking, Login & Locker Service Errors
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We're actively investigating errors players may see when trying to log in, matchmake, or access the Locker. We'll provide an update as soon as we have more information to share.

updates.title: Login failure to EOS Game Services with certain valid OpenId tokens.
updates.meta: Resolved / None / Resolved / We pushed a change to our IDP service that blocked some valid OpenId tokens. We rolled the change back on 5/27/2026 6:00am

updates.title: Stats Delayed
updates.meta: Resolved / Minor / Resolved / This incident has been resolved.

updates.title: Stats Delayed
updates.meta: Identified / Minor / Resolved / We are aware of delays impacting stats queries and reporting surfaces in Epic Online Services. Stats ingestion and processing are continuing normally, but some results may appear delayed while processing catches up.
